function.name: release_statdata
function.description: This function releases the memory allocated to the STATDATA structure and sets its pointers to NULL.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the STATDATA structure whose memory needs to be released.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything.

function.name: copy_statdata
function.description: This function copies the data from a source STATDATA object to a destination STATDATA object. If the destination object has an Advise Sink, it increases the reference count of the Advise Sink.

parameters.name: dst
parameters.description: This is the destination STATDATA object where the data will be copied to.

parameters.name: src
parameters.description: This is the source STATDATA object from where the data will be copied.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, otherwise it returns an error code.

function.name: impl_from_IEnumSTATDATA
function.description: This function returns a pointer to the EnumSTATDATA structure that contains the given IEnumSTATDATA interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IEnumSTATDATA interface

function.return_type: EnumSTATDATA *; Pointer to the EnumSTATDATA structure that contains the IEnumSTATDATA interface

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_QueryInterface
function.description: This function checks if the provided interface identifier (IID) matches either IID_IUnknown or IID_IEnumSTATDATA. If it does, it increments the reference count of the interface and returns a pointer to it.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumSTATDATA interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the interface identifier (IID)

parameters.name: ppv
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer that receives the interface pointer requested in riid

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function call. Returns S_OK if the interface is found, otherwise returns E_NOINTERFACE

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the EnumSTATDATA object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumSTATDATA interface

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Release
function.description: This function releases the resources associated with the EnumSTATDATA object. It decrements the reference count, and if the reference count is zero, it releases the statdata and the holder if it exists, and then frees the memory allocated for the EnumSTATDATA object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumSTATDATA interface of the object to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count of the object after it has been decremented. If the reference count is zero, the object has been freed.

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Next
function.description: This function is used to get the next set of STATDATA elements from the enumeration sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IEnumSTATDATA interface.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Number of STATDATA elements to retrieve.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the retrieved STATDATA elements are returned.

parameters.name: fetched
parameters.description: Pointer to the location where the number of actually retrieved STATDATA elements is returned.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if successful, S_FALSE if there are no more elements to retrieve.

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Skip
function.description: This function skips a specified number of elements in the EnumSTATDATA sequence.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an instance of IEnumSTATDATA interface.

parameters.name: num
parameters.description: Number of elements to skip in the sequence.

function.return_type: HRESULT, where S_OK indicates successful skip of elements and S_FALSE indicates that the end of the sequence is reached.

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Reset
function.description: This function resets the index of the EnumSTATDATA object to 0.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IEnumSTATDATA interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if the operation is successful.

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Clone
function.description: This function clones an EnumSTATDATA object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the interface of the EnumSTATDATA object to be cloned.

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Pointer to the pointer where the cloned EnumSTATDATA object will be stored.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. Otherwise, it returns an error code.

function.name: EnumSTATDATA_Construct
function.description: This function constructs an instance of EnumSTATDATA, allocates memory for it and initializes its properties. If the 'copy' parameter is true, it also copies the 'data' array into the newly allocated memory.

parameters.name: holder
parameters.description: Pointer to an unknown interface that holds the EnumSTATDATA instance.

parameters.name: index
parameters.description: Index to be assigned to the EnumSTATDATA instance.

parameters.name: array_len
parameters.description: Length of the 'data' array.

parameters.name: data
parameters.description: Pointer to the array of STATDATA to be copied if 'copy' is true.

parameters.name: copy
parameters.description: Flag indicating whether to copy the 'data' array into the newly allocated memory.

parameters.name: ppenum
parameters.description: Double pointer to the EnumSTATDATA interface, used to return the constructed EnumSTATDATA instance.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the function execution. It returns S_OK if the function executes successfully, otherwise it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY if memory allocation fails.

function.name: impl_from_IOleAdviseHolder
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IOleAdviseHolder interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This is a pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface.

function.return_type: OleAdviseHolderImpl pointer, representing the containing record for the given IOleAdviseHolder interface pointer.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_Destructor
function.description: This function releases the resources allocated to the OleAdviseHolderImpl object and its connections. It iterates through the connections and releases the statdata for each connection if it exists. Finally, it frees the memory allocated to the connections and the OleAdviseHolderImpl object itself.

parameters.name: This
parameters.description: A pointer to the OleAdviseHolderImpl object to be destructed.

function.return_type: void, this function does not return anything

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of an OleAdviseHolder object. It checks if the requested interface (identified by the iid parameter) is supported by the object. If it is, a pointer to that interface is returned through the obj parameter.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the OleAdviseHolder interface of the object.

parameters.name: iid
parameters.description: Identifier of the interface being requested.

parameters.name: obj
parameters.description: Address of a pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in iid. Upon successful return, *obj contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *obj is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT. If the method succeeds, the return value is S_OK. If the object does not support the interface, the return value is E_NOINTERFACE. If the obj parameter is NULL, the return value is E_POINTER.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of the OleAdviseHolderImpl object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: This parameter is a pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface.

function.return_type: ULONG, which represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_Release
function.description: This function releases an IOleAdviseHolder interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count reaches zero, the OleAdviseHolderImpl object is destroyed.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface that is to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the interface has been released

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_Advise
function.description: This function is used to establish a connection between an advise sink and an advise holder. It assigns a unique identifier to the connection and stores the advise sink and the connection identifier in the advise holder's connection array.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IOleAdviseHolder interface of the advise holder

parameters.name: pAdvise
parameters.description: Pointer to the IAdviseSink interface of the advise sink

parameters.name: pdwConnection
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD variable that receives the identifier of the connection

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, and E_POINTER if pdwConnection is NULL

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_Unadvise
function.description: This function unadvises a connection, releasing the associated resources if the connection exists.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: dwConnection
parameters.description: The connection to be unadvised

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error code if the operation fails

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_EnumAdvise
function.description: This function is used to construct an enumeration of the advisory connections on an object and then queries the interface for a pointer to this enumeration object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: enum_advise
parameters.description: Address of IEnumSTATDATA pointer variable that receives the interface pointer to the new enumerator object

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the success or failure of the function

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_SendOnRename
function.description: This function sends a rename notification to all advise sinks registered with the advise holder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface on the advise holder object.

parameters.name: pmk
parameters.description: Pointer to the IMoniker interface on the moniker that identifies the renamed object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the method succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_SendOnSave
function.description: This function sends a save notification to all advise sinks that are registered with the advise holder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface on the advise holder object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation was successful, the return value is S_OK.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_SendOnClose
function.description: This function sends a close notification to all advise sinks that are registered with the advise holder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder interface on the advise holder object.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the function succeeds, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: OleAdviseHolderImpl_Constructor
function.description: This function allocates memory for an OleAdviseHolderImpl object, initializes its properties and returns a pointer to its IOleAdviseHolder_iface property.
function.return_type: IOleAdviseHolder pointer, which represents the IOleAdviseHolder_iface property of the newly created OleAdviseHolderImpl object

function.name: impl_from_IDataAdviseHolder
function.description: This function returns the containing record for the given IDataAdviseHolder interface pointer.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to IDataAdviseHolder interface

function.return_type: DataAdviseHolder pointer, representing the containing record for the given IDataAdviseHolder interface pointer

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_Destructor
function.description: This function is a destructor for the DataAdviseHolder object. It releases the memory allocated for the connections and remote_connections arrays, as well as the DataAdviseHolder object itself. It also unadvises the IDataObject if the connection is remote and the delegate is not null.

parameters.name: ptrToDestroy
parameters.description: A pointer to the DataAdviseHolder object to be destroyed

function.return_type: void, this function does not return any value

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_QueryInterface
function.description: This function is used to query an interface of a DataAdviseHolder object. It checks if the requested interface is available, if not it returns an error. If the interface is available, it increases the reference count and returns S_OK.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: riid
parameters.description: Reference to the identifier of the interface being requested

parameters.name: ppvObject
parameters.description: Address of pointer variable that receives the interface pointer requested in riid. Upon successful return, *ppvObject contains the requested interface pointer. If the object does not support the interface, *ppvObject is set to NULL.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the call. Returns S_OK if the interface is supported, E_NOINTERFACE if not supported, and E_INVALIDARG if the passed arguments are not valid

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_AddRef
function.description: This function increments the reference count of a DataAdviseHolder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface of the DataAdviseHolder object.

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after increment.

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_Release
function.description: This function releases the IDataAdviseHolder interface and decrements the reference count. If the reference count is zero, it calls the destructor.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface to be released

function.return_type: ULONG, represents the new reference count after the release operation

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_Advise
function.description: This function sets up an advisory connection between a data object and an advise sink. It also manages the connections and reallocates memory when the maximum number of connections is reached.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: pDataObject
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataObject interface

parameters.name: pFetc
parameters.description: Pointer to a FORMATETC structure

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advisory flags

parameters.name: pAdvise
parameters.description: Pointer to an IAdviseSink interface

parameters.name: pdwConnection
parameters.description: Pointer to a DWORD in which to return the advisory connection

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK on success, and an error code on failure

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_Unadvise
function.description: This function unadvises a previously established advisory connection.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataAdviseHolder interface.

parameters.name: dwConnection
parameters.description: A token that specifies the connection to be removed.

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. Returns S_OK if successful, or an error value otherwise.

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_EnumAdvise
function.description: This function queries an interface for a pointer to another interface, constructs an enumeration object, releases the interface, and returns the HRESULT.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to an IDataAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: enum_advise
parameters.description: Pointer to a pointer to an IEnumSTATDATA interface

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the result of the function execution

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_SendOnDataChange
function.description: This function sends a data change notification to all advise sinks that are registered with the data advise holder object.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: data_obj
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject interface

parameters.name: dwReserved
parameters.description: Reserved, must be zero

parameters.name: advf
parameters.description: Advisory flags

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. S_OK if the operation was successful

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_OnConnect
function.description: This function connects to a DataAdviseHolder and sets up data advising for each connection that has an advise sink. It also sets the delegate for the DataAdviseHolder.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface

parameters.name: pDelegate
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataObject to be set as the delegate

function.return_type: HRESULT, represents the status of the operation. If the operation is successful, it returns S_OK. If it fails, it returns an error code.

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_OnDisconnect
function.description: This function disconnects all remote connections in a DataAdviseHolder object and sets the delegate to NULL.

parameters.name: iface
parameters.description: Pointer to the IDataAdviseHolder interface of the DataAdviseHolder object

function.return_type: void, this function does not return a value

function.name: DataAdviseHolder_Constructor
function.description: This function allocates memory for a new DataAdviseHolder object, initializes its properties, and returns a pointer to its IDataAdviseHolder_iface property.
function.return_type: IDataAdviseHolder pointer, representing the IDataAdviseHolder_iface property of the newly created DataAdviseHolder object

function.name: CreateOleAdviseHolder
function.description: This function creates an OLE advise holder object and assigns it to the provided pointer. If the pointer is null, it returns an error. If the creation of the advise holder fails, it also returns an error.

parameters.name: ppOAHolder
parameters.description: A pointer to a pointer to an IOleAdviseHolder object. The function will create a new OLE advise holder and assign it to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which represents the status of the operation. It returns S_OK if the operation is successful, E_POINTER if the provided pointer is null, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if the creation of the advise holder fails.

function.name: CreateDataAdviseHolder
function.description: This function creates a Data Advise Holder and assigns it to the provided pointer. It checks if the pointer is null and returns an error if it is. If the Data Advise Holder is successfully created, it returns S_OK. If it fails to create the Data Advise Holder, it returns E_OUTOFMEMORY.

parameters.name: ppDAHolder
parameters.description: This is a pointer to a pointer to an IDataAdviseHolder object. The function will attempt to create a Data Advise Holder and assign it to this pointer.

function.return_type: HRESULT, which is a type used to represent error codes. It returns S_OK if the function succeeds, E_POINTER if the provided pointer is null, and E_OUTOFMEMORY if it fails to create the Data Advise Holder.
